description: This file defines a React functional component called `Internships` that manages the display and interaction of internship listings, including search, filtering, and application functionalities. It imports external APIs and internationalization context, and maintains internal state for user input and data display.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Fetches internship data based on current query and location filters, updates the items state, and manages loading state.

methods.name: externalUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for internship details, prioritizing certain fields and providing defaults.

methods.name: onApply
methods.description: Attempts to apply to an internship; on failure, redirects to an external URL.
